description: Source code for a VPN server implementation, specifically for Linux, involving TUN interface setup, socket communication, and tunnel management.

methods.name: get_interface
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves a TUN interface by name.

methods.name: get_tunnel
methods.description: Sets up an IPv6 UDP socket, binds to a port, and waits for a secret-matching packet to establish a tunnel.

methods.name: build_parameters
methods.description: Constructs a parameter string from command-line arguments for VPN configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, sets up TUN interface, and manages tunnel communication loop.
